help.goal: Draw your secret word so the others can type it, and guess theirs. Most points wins.
steps: On your turn, read the word shown at the top.
Drag your finger on the pad to draw it.
Tap one of the five dots to change pen, or clear to wipe.
When someone else draws, type your guess and tap Guess.
Guess as often as you like; wrong guesses cost nothing.
notes: The first player to get it scores 3, everyone after that 2.
The drawer earns 1 point for every player who guesses the word.
Each drawing lasts 75 seconds; the dashes show how long the word is.
